**Tier 9.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `account`, `activity`, `auth`, `cart`, `catalog`, `chat`, `commerce`, `contact`, `customers`, `delivery`, `identity`, `invoicing`, `loyalty`, `messaging`, `orders`, `payments`, `plugins`, `seo`, `settings`, `shipping`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `commerce`, `customers`, `delivery`, `orders`, `payments`, `plugins`, `settings`, `settlement`.

Feature map entry: `checkout` in [docs/features.json](../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm run feature -- checkout` for its full span.
